purpose: First physical 8 GB candidate: a small MiniMax H3 image-to-video clip with native audio. It is a hypothesis, not a compatibility claim.

observed_on_other_machine.notes: One cold 15.92 GiB RTX 5080 run with reserve pressure; it is not physical 8 GB certification.

engine.family: MiniMax H3 FL2VA I2V native audio

required_live_proof: object_info must expose every required_core_nodes class.
The direct runner must bind each custom-node provider's root, Git commit, and source hash into the laptop receipt.
No Manager, SageAttention flag, reserve-vram flag, or unwhitelisted custom node is admitted.

follow_up_ladder.caveat: A newer 5080 cold receipt reached 33.34 GiB host RAM, so it must earn its own 4060 result.

follow_up_ladder.status: only after the short native-audio candidate passes

blockers_before_launch: The laptop-local inventory receipt must have status READY_FOR_HUMAN_BOOT_APPROVAL.
A later admission step must query the laptop-owned server and prove all required models and nodes are present.
The later direct runner must be separately implemented and reviewed; this JSON never queues a prompt.
